description: This file implements streaming encoder and decoder interfaces for runtime objects in Kubernetes, including concrete implementations for encoding and decoding streams of objects over io.Reader and io.Writer.

classes.name: decoder
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the Decoder interface for streaming decoding of runtime objects.

classes.name: encoder
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the Encoder interface for streaming encoding of runtime objects.

methods.name: NewDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new streaming decoder that reads object chunks from an io.ReadCloser.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Reads and decodes the next object from the stream.

methods.name: NewEncoder
methods.description: Creates a new streaming encoder that writes objects to an io.Writer.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a runtime.Object and writes it to the stream.
